# Fixture catalog

A tiny, real catalog used by tests. Every PRD extends it with exactly the subjects,
collections and products it needs to prove its acceptance criteria.

Rules:

- Source PNGs here are small and hand-made (or generated by a script committed
  alongside them). They exist to exercise code paths, not to look good.
- Include subjects that deliberately trip each cut-file finding type once PRD 3 lands.
- Never point the tool's tests at a real catalog.

Populated by PRD 1.
